# Remaining customer-dependent tasks

Apply the [shared contract](README.md). These are small route extensions, chosen
by the first eligible customer dependency, not a demand to finish every provider
before returning to the customer queue. Implement only the named branch, with
focused host refusals and installed public-result/evidence/cleanup checks.
Split implementation from live qualification before starting if both cannot fit.

| Done | ID / budget | Requires | Bounded deliverable and measurable acceptance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ ] | L01 / 55 min | R03/R04, customer 005a/004 | **Host terminal authentication:** bind one declared package-command challenge to the intended administrator and non-echoing input, preserving two fresh proofs and single-use delivery. Generic `Password:` text alone refuses. Wrong recipient, stale proof, echo and uncertain-input regressions pass. |
| [ ] | L02 / 55 min | L01; customer 006 command/result leaves; prepared product-free attempt | **VM package install:** type the declared install command once, service its real challenge if offered, observe completion/notice and the prescribed public product result. Capture/cleanup pass. This supplies customer 005/006; update/remove/purge remain their own queue tasks. |
| [ ] | L03 / 50 min | S02, G06; customer 042 | **Lock prompt:** use the normal Lock action; resolve the intended user's actual lock challenge, sole empty masked focused field and blocked desktop input. Wrong-recipient/ambiguous-surface refusal and cleanup pass. No unlock or natural-expiry claim yet. |
| [ ] | L04 / 55 min | L03; customer 043a challenge leaves | **Retained unlock:** one fresh same-user proof pair and secret submission returns to the previously observed desktop/activity. Wrong-recipient and reused-proof refusal pass; a new login/window cannot satisfy retention. Explicit time-limit denial is a separate branch in its customer task. |
| [ ] | L05 / 50 min | R02; customer 044a | **Same-desktop window switch:** alternate between two declared already-open surfaces through normal switching, reacquire each owner and compare its preserved public draft/state. No title/position selection outside the Shell adapter; no relaunch. |
| [ ] | L06 / 55 min | S02; customer 007 recorder transition ready | **Reboot:** operate normal Shell reboot/confirmation and observe fresh GDM in one continuous attempt. Record transition/capture reconciliation and cleanup. No reset or ACPI-maintenance shortcut as the customer step. |
| [ ] | L07 / 50 min | S02; customer 193 | **Network control:** change the declared connection through Shell's ordinary UI and independently observe displayed disconnected/connected states. Host wrong-control/uncertain-input checks and VM cleanup pass. Feedback retry/offline scenarios remain separate consumers. |
| [ ] | L08 / 55 min | L03/L04; customer 166 bounded wait/wake ready | **Suspend/wake:** invoke the normal action, wait the declared real interval, wake with qualified normal input and observe the actual return/lock state. No hidden service result. Evidence/cleanup pass; subsequent unlock uses L04. |
| [ ] | L09 / 55 min | R02; customer 035a declared native fixture | **DING desktop launch:** bind the real desktop-icon provider and launch exactly the declared fixture through its icon. Observe the owned fixture's usable public result and wrong-icon refusal. No substitution with search or terminal. |
| [ ] | L10 / 45 min | A08; named notification consumer identified first | **Notification:** qualify only that consumer's Shell notification identity, required content and one dismissal with observed disappearance. Unknown/ambiguous notification refuses. No named consumer means defer; do not build general notification handling. |
| [ ] | U01 / 55 min | R02, A08; customer 184a | **Settings Users Unlock:** open the actual Users page, use easy Builder IDs plus scoped semantics, authenticate the distinct Unlock challenge and observe unlocked controls. Reject wrong account/page/dialog. No account mutation yet. |
| [ ] | U02 / 55 min | U01; customer 184 disposable-account/password leaves | **Add child:** operate the one declared account-creation wizard, protect baseline accounts and secret recipients, then independently observe the new account and Parent discovery. Duplicate/wrong-account refusal, sealed capture and cleanup pass. |
| [ ] | U03 / 50 min | U02; customer 184b | **Remove child:** remove only the declared logged-out disposable account, observe its absence and the required Parent result. Refuse protected or ambiguous accounts. Preserve intended removal confirmations and cleanup. |
| [ ] | U04 / 50 min | U01; customer 184c spare approver | **Change role:** change only the declared spare account's offered role, then observe role and public approver eligibility. Wrong/protected account refuses. No account-database probe as acceptance. |
| [ ] | U05 / 50 min | S01, R02; customer 191 | **Date/time read:** qualify the actual clock/calendar and Settings timezone projections; return displayed local date/time/timezone with locale-aware parsing. No clock changes. Ambiguous/unavailable fields refuse. Natural midnight/DST scenarios remain scheduled customer work. |
| [ ] | U06 / 50 min | R02, L05; customer 185p or 185o selected destination | **One external information destination:** identify the actual browser/mail/document handler for one offered link, qualify its public destination identity and normal close/return. No mail/report submission. Repeat as separately named sub-tasks for each remaining destination; never claim all INFO01 links from one handler. |
| [ ] | U07 / 40 min | A named retained graphical-VT6 consumer actually needs it | **Graphical console feasibility:** briefly inspect the public recipient/input route, including source/docs if useful. Record whether ownership, recipient, non-echoing input and capture proofs can be established. If yes, create separate at-most-one-hour implementation and live tasks; otherwise record a concrete blocker. Serial proof cannot authorize graphical secret input. This diagnosis never qualifies a login route. |

Shell-owned reveal/window navigation can support the child extension, but the
extension's `child-*` controls and repository-owned app/game fixtures still use
their public IDs. Qualify those through customer **048, 052, 181h/181m, 047** and
their installed consumers. Natural expiry, fullscreen play, retained-user
histories and multi-desktop support require their full recipes; manual Lock,
one window switch or an adapter test cannot replace them.

For every new user-facing integration, consult
[package activation](../../Publishing.md#package-update-activation). Pure test
adapters change no product service or saved data. Do not add policy-generation
acknowledgement work, portal changes, broad setup grants or unrelated system
coverage to these tasks.
